verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents event-driven automation in its ingestion layer. Webhooks receive external events and trigger ingestion workflows, and an AI Editor lets users build and edit those workflows in natural language. Configurable AI risk auto-scoring thresholds and continuous monitoring alerts add some rule-driven behavior. However, the evidence shows no general user-defined rule engine (if-event-then-action) beyond data ingestion and preset monitoring. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose trigger/condition/action rule builder, outbound actions (e.g., auto-creating tickets or notifications on custom events), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
